fz-ts-footnote-row.owner: server (Rust typeset rows); client side checked by ui-51
fz-ts-footnote-row.why: after typing in a footnote's text the run's own satex/typeset rows (satexTypesetOrigins) hold the footnote twice: the new text (line 3) and the old `1A short note.` (line 8), also after the run lands; the client shows what it gets. Needs the server to drop the previous run's footnote insert. Timing dependent (1 of 3 runs)

sync-usetikzlibrary.owner: server (Rust rerun from a checkpoint); evidence by ui-51
sync-usetikzlibrary.why: the client is in sync (last didChange text == editor text, findings version == sent version), but the wasm run of the final text reads `\\use`/`\\useti` (the name as an earlier run met it mid-typing) followed by `tikzlibrary…` as text: a rerun resumes inside line 3 with the old token; native `satex lint` of the final text is clean

sync-stray-brace.why: the wasm server publishes an empty diagnostics list for the text's version (raw publishDiagnostics captured: `diagnostics: []`), also with the brace there from the start (no resume), while native `satex lint` of the same text reports C013 `Too many }'s` at 8:18: the client shows what it gets

tc-type-begin-arg.owner: server (Rust: environment effects for the echo) + Type-mode echo
tc-type-begin-arg.why: the echo no longer prints the environment's name, but sets \begin{center} Quokka \end{center} on the row typed in, while TeX starts a centred row a \topsep lower: the caret jumps ~50 px as the build lands. A fix without a name table needs the run to report, per environment name, what its begin code leaves: the vertical space it adds (\topsep, \partopsep, \parskip as \@trivlist adds them, ltlists.dtx) and the paragraph shape it sets (\leftskip, \rightskip, \parfillskip: \centering's 0pt plus 1fil), e.g. in the page view's run lengths or a satex/envEffect query

forest-child.owner: server (wasm text sync); evidence by ui-61
forest-child.why: under load the snapshot printer answers `a place outside the text` (src/lsp/snapshot.rs edits_of): the wasm server holds an older, shorter text of hello.tex than the editor, though the client sent the scenario's text (didChange v2, 1359 chars) before the request. Intermittent: passed 1 of 2 runs (forest-sibling 2 of 3); evidence target/scratch/ui-61/dbg-forest.log
forest-child.match: ^source unchanged \(toast: a place outside the text\)
